message:
app tests: keep the test certificate's serial a minimal DER integer

The cluster-node test certificate cleared only the sign bit of its random 16-byte serial, so about one serial in 256 began with a zero byte that DER forbids, and OpenSSL refused the certificate with illegal padding. bounds.test.ts failed that way on CI at 47ea1bb91. The first byte is now always 0x40 to 0x7f: 0 of 20,000 generated certificates refused, against 9 of 4,000 before.
